about:
Assembly Solutions is headquartered in Bridgeton, Missouri. The company was founded in 2001 by four entrepreneurs in an incubator facility in St. Charles, Missouri, recognizing the growing demand for reliable contract manufacturing.

The company provides full-service electronic contract manufacturing, including printed circuit board assemblies (through-hole and surface-mount), cable and harness assemblies, electromechanical box builds, comprehensive testing, and engineering design services. Its integrated facility handles projects ranging from small custom runs to high-volume production, supported by a senior team with over 40 years of combined expertise in materials management, production control, quality assurance, and engineering.

Assembly Solutions serves original equipment manufacturers across agriculture, aviation, construction and mining, general manufacturing, medical, LED lighting and chargers, video and surveillance, and industrial controls. The company emphasizes turnkey solutions from concept to finished product, reducing time to market for OEM customers.

The company differentiates itself through its one-stop manufacturing model, consolidating PCB assembly, cable harness, box build, testing, and design under one roof. Quality is governed by ISO 9001:2015 certification and adherence to IPC-A-610 Class II/III, J-STD-001, and UL/CSA/CE standards, with formal PPAP and FMEA processes. The founders started the business to address the need for dependable, scalable electronic manufacturing in the region.
